baseline_reuse: The identical 512-state unadapted development outputs from V2 are reused by SHA-256; they are not rerun on GPU.
reason: The first 64-state disposable fixture reduced loss and learned R headers, EOS, and deletion, but both finalists output R for every no-edit case. Its gate correctly stopped main training. The diagnostic was harder than a format check and made no-edit discrimination invisible to the trainer check. No development or held-out adaptation quality was observed.

v3_fixture.gate: At least one exact no-edit and deletion, and a valid terminated action for every action family. Main pilot data and development split remain unchanged.
v3_fixture.hint: Explicit action/header cue after the ordinary prompt; replacement bytes supplied only for insertion/replacement. This checks serialization, EOS, and learnability rather than useful editing.
v3_fixture.source: disposable synthetic family 99, not present in train/development/heldout
